texts.zh:
[attacking_country.GetName]攻击了[victim_country.GetName]！帝国的成员国收到外部势力的攻击需要[Root.GetRulerTitle]的立即反应。

[Root.GetName]需要介入这场战争吗？帝国的其他成员都在翘首以盼。
texts.en:
The [attacking_country.GetName] has attacked the [victim_country.GetName]! This attack on an Imperial member state by an outside power requires an immediate response from the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

Should the [Root.GetName] intervene in this war? The rest of the Imperium is watching closely.

label.zh: 他们的仗就是我们的仗，开战！
label.en: Their fight is our fight. To war!

tooltips.en: We join the [From.From.GetName] on the side of the [victim_country.GetName]

label.en: This war does not concern us.

texts.zh: [attacking_country.GetName]对我们国家发起的懦弱的袭击已经招致了[From.GetRulerTitle]闪电般的反应！帝国的舰队正从[From.GetName]开来，支援我们的这场战争。
texts.en: The cowardly attack on our nation by the [attacking_country.GetName] has prompted the [From.GetRulerTitle] to take swift action! Imperial fleets from the [From.GetName] are now moving to support us in this war.

tooltips.en: The [From.GetName] joins the [From.From.From.GetName] on our side.

texts.zh: 我们最近对一个星海帝国成员国[victim_country.GetName]的袭击，已经招致了[From.GetRulerTitle]迅速的反应！现在我们已经和[From.GetName]陷入了战争状态。
texts.en: Our recent attack on the [victim_country.GetName], a member of the Galactic Imperium, has provoked an immediate response from the [From.GetRulerTitle]! A state of war now exists between us and the [From.GetName].

label.en: This war is none of their concern!

tooltips.zh: [From.GetName]加入了[From.From.From.GetName]并站在我们的对立面。
tooltips.en: The [From.GetName] joins the [From.From.From.GetName] on the side of our enemies.

texts.zh: 尽管[attacking_country.GetName]对我们的国家展开了懦弱的袭击，[From.GetRulerTitle]决定不为我们介入干预！我们现在需要自求生路，而帝国的舰队则在远处冷眼旁观。
texts.en: Despite the cowardly attack on our nation by the [attacking_country.GetName], the [From.GetRulerTitle] has decided not to intervene on our behalf! We have been left to fend for ourselves, while Imperial fleets observe the conflict from afar.
